title: A Small Hello at Round Pond
synopsis: Amy and Ben meet Kim, a careful observer of ripples, and find that friendship can begin with a quiet shared moment.
continuity_state: Before: Kim only glimpsed. After: Amy and Ben know Kim and her violet pouch with three pebbles; Round Pond, willow and rings drawn; Kim may choose to attend walk.

related_resources.reason: A child may care about a friend without demanding participation; source covers adult-guided social cooperation, not an established benefit of this plot.
